description: This Java class, TaxConfiguration, defines configuration settings related to tax calculations within a shopping or e-commerce system. It includes properties such as tax basis calculation method and whether to collect tax in cases of different provinces or countries than the store's location. Implements JSONAware for JSON serialization.

classes.name: TaxConfiguration
classes.description: A model class that encapsulates various tax configuration settings for a merchant, including calculation basis and conditions for tax collection based on geographic differences.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the tax configuration object into a JSON string representation.

methods.name: setTaxBasisCalculation
methods.description: Sets the tax basis calculation method.

methods.name: getTaxBasisCalculation
methods.description: Retrieves the current tax basis calculation method.

methods.name: setCollectTaxIfDifferentProvinceOfStoreCountry
methods.description: Sets whether to collect tax when the province differs from the store's country.

methods.name: isCollectTaxIfDifferentProvinceOfStoreCountry
methods.description: Checks whether to collect tax when the province differs from the store's country.

methods.name: setCollectTaxIfDifferentCountryOfStoreCountry
methods.description: Sets whether to collect tax when the country differs from the store's country.

methods.name: isCollectTaxIfDifferentCountryOfStoreCountry
methods.description: Checks whether to collect tax when the country differs from the store's country.
